name: cryonics-monitor
author: Pebble Cryonics Monitor contributors
_comment_companionApp: companionApp is deliberately NOT declared in the pebble section. Declaring companionApp.android.apps[].package makes the Core app route AppMessages through PebbleKit2 (a bound-service protocol we don't implement yet) and show 'needs a companion app' on launch; with no declaration it falls back to PebbleKit Classic broadcast intents, which android/ implements. Re-add when migrating to PebbleKitAndroid2 (M2).
